Fail closed on object-shaped coordinate fields

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-6
  description: |-
    Object and array values under repository/organization coordinate keys were recursively accepted when they lacked recognized nested keys, so unverifiable foreign coordinates such as repo:{name,owner_name} could ride beside approved full_name/owner pointers. Reject those unsupported shapes unless the closed catalog declares nested pointers for that exact path, and only lease-check string collection elements.
